title: strigilia pavonii
intro: Strigilia pavonii, commonly known as the Indian Strigilia, is a plant species found in India and Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Strigilia pavonii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in alleviating symptoms of cough, cold, and flu. The bioactive constituents present in Strigilia pavonii include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
